title: Free simplicial resolutions for conservative realization-preserving right adjoints
statement: Use the universe and infinity-category conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and coherent diagrams and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal X,\mathcal B$ be infinity-categories and let $L:\mathcal B\rightleftarrows\mathcal X:R$ be a coherent adjunction: $L$ is left adjoint to $R$, via natural equivalences $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal X}(Lb,x)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal B}(b,Rx)$. Suppose $\mathcal X$ admits all small geometric realizations, meaning colimits of coherent diagrams indexed by $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$, and $R$ preserves these colimits and reflects equivalences. For every $x\in\mathcal X$ there exist a coherent simplicial diagram $P:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal X$ and a colimiting cocone $P\to\operatorname{const}(x)$ such that, for every integer $n\geq0$, there are $b_n\in\mathcal B$ and an equivalence $P_n\simeq L(b_n)$. No assertion that the objects $b_n$ form a simplicial diagram in $\mathcal B$ is imposed.

source.place: Higher Algebra (2017), Proposition 4.7.3.14, printed p.689, using conditions (1) and (2) of Theorem 4.7.3.5. The present hypotheses require all geometric realizations rather than only the right-adjoint-split ones. No Stacks tag for this infinity-categorical theorem.

proof.text: In [lem-coef-infinity-monadic-bar] substitute $\mathcal C=\mathcal B$, $\mathcal D=\mathcal X$ and $U=R$, leaving $L$ unchanged. The adjunction has the same orientation. Its hypotheses hold: $\mathcal X$ admits geometric realizations and $R$ preserves them by assumption, and conservative means exactly the assumed reflection of equivalences. Both statements use coherent diagrams and colimiting cocones in the conventions of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. The simplex category is small in the fixed universe, so the small-realization hypothesis covers its indexing shape.

source.place: Auxiliary specialization of the hypotheses of lem-coef-infinity-monadic-bar; compare Higher Algebra Theorem 4.7.3.5(c), printed p.685.

proof.text: Apply the augmented-bar conclusion of [lem-coef-infinity-monadic-bar] to $Z=x$. It supplies a coherent simplicial object $P=B_\bullet x$ and its counit augmentation $P\to\operatorname{const}(x)$ having geometric realization $x$. This is the colimiting cocone required here: the cited statement explicitly uses the coherent comma-cocone definition of colimitingness. Its assertion includes the coherent face and degeneracy data, rather than only maps in a homotopy category.

source.place: Generic bar foundation for the middle finite-level mapping-complex adjunction; Higher Algebra Proposition 4.7.3.14 and Remark 4.7.3.15, printed p.689.

proof.text: For each $n\geq0$ set $b_n=(RL)^nRx\in\mathcal B$: start with $b_0=Rx$ and iterate the endofunctor $RL$ of $\mathcal B$. The formula $B_nx=L(RL)^nRx$ in [lem-coef-infinity-monadic-bar] gives $P_n\simeq L(b_n)$. These choices are made separately in each degree. The statement asks for no simplicial structure on $b_n$, so the diagram and cocone of step 2 together with these objects satisfy every clause.

source.place: Extraction of degree objects from the existing bar formula; Higher Algebra Remark 4.7.3.15, printed p.689.
